requirements.text: When renameCategory is called for a default category, it must update every saved receipt whose category matches the old name case‑insensitively to the new name, leaving all other receipt fields unchanged, removing the old name from getAllCategories, preventing syncCategoriesWithReceipts from re‑adding it, and making isCategoryInUse(newName) return true.

When renameCategory is called for a custom category, it must update every saved receipt whose category matches the old name case‑insensitively to the new name, leaving all other receipt fields unchanged, removing the old name from getAllCategories, preventing syncCategoriesWithReceipts from re‑adding it, and making isCategoryInUse(newName) return true.
If renameCategory fails because the new name is invalid, already exists, or the category is not found, no receipts may be modified.

validateMileageMiles must accept any numeric value greater than 0 with up to one decimal place (e.g., 12.5) and reject 0, negative numbers, numbers with more than one decimal place (e.g., 12.55), and non‑numeric text.
The Miles input field on the Add mileage screen must allow entry of a decimal string such as "12.5".
The deduction displayed on the Add mileage screen and the value saved to storage must use the exact decimal mileage value entered.
The Receipt and Mileage add buttons and the "Receipt saved" confirmation must never overlap the Recent activity list.
Each row in the Recent activity list must display its amount.
The Recent activity list must be scrollable past the add buttons.
The bottom tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) must be fully visible on a 390x844 pixel phone screen.
The Add receipt screen title must appear only once, in the header.
The date picker icon must be positioned inside the Date field.
There must be no empty gaps larger than the standard spacing between fields on the Add receipt screen.
The "Scan receipt" button must not be displayed while scanning functionality is unavailable.
In Settings, the App lock option must appear only once as a switch row, with no separate App lock button.
In Settings, the entries Tax settings, Categories, Export, Backup & restore, View Terms and Privacy Policy must be rendered as list rows with a chevron, not as outlined buttons.
In Settings, the Delete all data entry must be displayed in the error colour, positioned last, and separated from the other entries.
All existing features, tests, and screens must remain functional and unchanged.

R2.gap: No test exercises renameCategory for a custom category

R3.gap: No test verifies that receipts remain unchanged when renameCategory fails due to invalid name, duplicate name, or missing category

R6.gap: Test checks stored mileage value and deduction calculation, but does not verify the displayed deduction on the Add mileage screen
